## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Search ad (headline + description), UK audience.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Organic Loose Leaf Tea" | Supported by Soil Association certification; loose leaf is a product fact. OK |
| "Loved by 50,000 tea drinkers" | **Unproven.** Not on the policy list. The only audience figure is 4.8/5 from 1,200+ reviews. "Loved by" is also a superlative-style popularity claim. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On policy list. OK |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On policy list. OK |

**Regulated claims:** Touches price/offer (free delivery threshold). It matches the policy and is stated with its condition, so it passes. No health, green or urgency wording.

**House style:** No banned words or AI tells visible. Short and plain. Passes.

**Disclosure:** A search ad is the brand's own ad on a platform that labels it as an ad itself. No creator, affiliate or AI-content issue. Passes.

**Fixed (suggested edit)**
- Removed the unsupported "50,000" figure and replaced it with a provable claim:

> Headline: Organic Loose Leaf Tea | Description: Rated 4.8/5 from over 1,200 reviews. Certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

Alternatively, if 50,000 is real (e.g. customer count), send me the source and it can be added to the policy before use.

**Needs a decision**
- Confirm whether the 50,000 figure has a source. Without one, use the edited version above.
- The landing page must also back up the claims (organic certification, review rating, delivery threshold).

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you to the exact final text above. Nothing is approved yet, and I have not recorded any approval.

**Verdict:** Do not publish the draft as written.
